geometric correction and resampling effects on the land cover classifications, and the study results can be used for future researches.

geometric correction and resampling processes are important steps in image processing, because they determine the positional accuracy of data.
the third order polynomial equation with nearest neighbour resampling is the most suitable geometric correction and resampling model in the Kulon Progo study area.

the geometric correction using third order polynomial and the resampling using nearest neighbour interpolation would be the best combination for geometric correction of Landsat 7 ETM+ and Landsat 8 imagery.
